summary: Frontend-only verification of 4 vendor-suite features for Lee (is_vendor=true, pin 516001). All 4 features PASSED end-to-end.

feature_results.F1_vendor_menu_trim: PASS - sidebar present; nav-network=0, nav-services=0; nav-dashboard/shop/wishlist/wallet/vendor all present. On /dashboard: dashboard-referral-tree=0, qa-services=0, qa-shop=1, qa-withdraw=1.
feature_results.F2_wishlist_heart: PASS - Clicking wishlist-toggle-<id> flips aria-pressed false->true without navigation (URL unchanged, still /shop). After full reload, aria-pressed remains true (state seeded from /me/wishlist). Untoggle also works and persists.
feature_results.F3_location_pincode_filter: PASS - shop-nearby-toggle exists, label='Deliverable to 516001' by default (ON). After click label becomes 'Showing all areas'. Product count with OFF (200) is >= ON (200). Toggling back ON still yields 200. Note: exact same 200 count suggests either (a) all seeded products deliver to 516001 or (b) a hard cap/pagination of 200 - satisfies the equal-or-more requirement but worth confirming there is no client-side limit truncating both lists.
feature_results.F4_wallet_vendor_earnings: PASS - wallet-vendor-earnings tile renders with text 'Vendor earnings (paid on delivery): ₹10'; wallet-balance also present ('₹10'); wallet page does not crash.

action_items: Non-blocking: Dashboard still fires GET /api/network for vendors returning 404 (console error 'Dashboard.network failed AxiosError: Request failed with status code 404'). Since vendors hide the referral tree, this call should be skipped when user.is_vendor to avoid noisy 404s.

Informational: /shop products-grid returns exactly 200 items both with nearby ON and OFF. Confirm there is no client-side .slice(0,200) capping the list; if there is, the 'equal-or-more' guarantee could be masked when the underlying dataset grows.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx should gate the /network fetch behind !user.is_vendor (parallel to the referral-tree render gate) to avoid 404 spam in console for vendor accounts.
Shop.jsx: verify that the pincode filter is applied before any list truncation/pagination so OFF really can show > ON.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled wishlist heart and reverted it during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 vendor-suite features work as specified. Only cosmetic finding is a 404 on GET /api/network fired from Dashboard for vendors - main agent may want to skip that call when is_vendor. Vendor test account Lee@gmail.com / Just@4me is functional.
